report:
Problem | Selected approach | Benefit | Cost/risk | Verification
margin_check.py suffered from module-level mutable state (_MARGIN_ALERTS), duplicated notional calculation in multiple branches, interleaving of CSV parsing with policy evaluation, and nested conditionals. It also required extending support for instrument_type='FUTURE' with a 0.10 margin rate. | Executed sequenced behavior-preserving refactoring before feature addition: (1) Added passing characterization tests pinning existing behaviors, (2) Applied Split Phase (R7) extracting typed Position and parsing functions, (3) Consolidated duplicated notional computation onto Position.notional (R12), (4) Encapsulated state into MarginChecker and MarginReport while deleting module-level _MARGIN_ALERTS per R13, replacing nested conditionals with dictionary dispatch, and preserving evaluate_csv_lines compatibility, and (5) Added FUTURE with Decimal('0.10') margin rate and corresponding unit tests. | Callers can evaluate margin in-memory without string parsing or global state pollution; zero duplicated math; clean O(1) rate dispatch; backwards-compatible entry point preserved. | Low risk; behavior strictly characterization-tested before and after refactoring. | Verified with 12 unit tests covering all instrument types (EQUITY, OPTION, FUTURE), concentration alerts, negative quantities, malformed rows, unsupported types, consecutive-run isolation, and direct MarginChecker usage; passed Ruff check, Ruff format check, and Mypy strict type check.

- ruff check --no-cache (passed, 0 errors)
